items.title: Stock Radar: United Spirits stock bounces back after testing 200-DMA in July 2026; likely to hit fresh record highs
items.description: United Spirits stock has bounced back, showing strong bullish signals on daily charts.  Experts suggest buying the stock for a target of Rs 1,700 in coming months.  The company benefits from premiumization trends and potential trade agreements with the UK.  Technical indicators like moving averages and RSI confirm a sustained uptrend.  A strict stop loss at Rs 1,270 is recommended for this investment.

items.title: Delhi HC orders winding up of Paytm Payments Bank, appoints former SBI official as liquidator
items.description: The Delhi High Court has issued a ruling for the liquidation of Paytm Payments Bank Ltd, following the Reserve Bank of India's decision to annul its banking license due to major concerns regarding management practices and regulatory compliance. An official liquidator will oversee the bank's dissolution, but it is important to note that this action does not impact other Paytm services.

items.title: FIIs cut stakes in 7 Nifty IT stocks. Then the index surged 16% in July
items.description: Foreign investors reduced stakes in most Nifty IT stocks during the June quarter. Oracle Financial Services Software saw the largest foreign investor stake increase. Mutual funds also cut holdings in nine of ten Nifty IT companies. Some foreign investors now see opportunities in beaten-down IT valuations. Sector growth faces challenges from artificial intelligence and global economic factors.

items.title: Shree Balaji (Mala) Textiles shares to list today; GMP signals massive 80% listing gain
items.description: Shree Balaji (Mala) Textiles is set for its stock market debut today on the BSE SME platform. The company's shares are showing a strong grey market premium of 80%. Its recent IPO received an overwhelming subscription of over 186 times overall. Proceeds from the issue will primarily strengthen the company's working capital needs. Shree Balaji Textiles manufactures and distributes cotton sarees under the "Mala Saree" brand.

items.title: Hindustan Unilever among 5 stocks crossing below VWAP, signalling bearish trend
items.description: On July 29, the closing prices of five stocks from the Nifty 500 pack dropped relative to their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP). A shift below the VWAP suggests a potential bearish trend, according to data from StockEdge.com.When the closing price falls below the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is lower than the average price at which the stock traded throughout the day, weighted by trading volume. This is often interpreted as an indication of increased selling pressure.

items.title: Inox Wind shares in focus after bagging Rs 1,600-crore order from NLC India
items.description: Inox Wind secured a repeat 200 MW turnkey order from NLC India worth Rs 1,600 crore. This project involves end-to-end execution and will be commissioned within twenty-four months. The company's order book now stands at 4.7 GW, strengthening its market position. Inox Wind's CEO expressed confidence in growth visibility and timely project delivery. The company remains focused on supporting India's clean energy goals and stakeholder value.

items.title: Radico Khaitan among 4 stocks that closed above VWAP, signalling bullish shift
items.description: On July 28, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 500 pack closed above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP). A shift above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, according to data from StockEdge.com.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which the stock traded throughout the day, weighted by trading volume. This occurrence is often interpreted as a potential bullish signal by traders and investors, indicating positive sentiment in the market.

items.title: TVS Motor among 6 Nifty 500 stocks flashing bullish White Marubozu signal
items.description: On July 28, six Nifty 500 stocks appeared on StockEdge's White Marubozu bullish scanner. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern that forms when a stock opens at its lowest price of the session and closes at its highest, indicating sustained buying interest throughout the trading day.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with little or no lower shadow and no upper shadow, the pattern signals strong buying pressure from open to close. Traders often view it as a sign of bullish momentum and use it to identify potential buying opportunities.

items.title: Swiggy among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 28, four stocks from the Nifty 500 index that gained more than 3% were identified using the RSI Trending Up scan on StockEdge.com. The scan generates a bullish signal when the Relative Strength Index (RSI) crosses above 50 from below, indicating strengthening price momentum. A rising RSI may signal potential upside and help traders identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Negative Breakout: Suzlon Energy among 8 stocks that crossed below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, eight stocks' closing prices crossed below their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on July 28, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Trading below the 200 DMA is considered a negative signal because it indicates that the stock's price is below its long-term trend line. The 200 DMA is used as a key indicator by traders for determining the overall trend in a particular stock. Take a look:

items.title: Adani Energy QIP gets 3.1x bids
items.description: Adani Energy Solutions' ₹3,500 crore qualified institutional placement saw strong demand. The issue was subscribed 3.1 times, drawing bids worth ₹10,841 crore. Domestic mutual funds and insurers participated actively in the offering. Foreign investors like Manulife and Fiera Capital also joined the placement. The company priced its shares at a discount to market rates.

items.title: UCO Bank plans $500-million overseas fundraise
items.description: UCO Bank plans to raise $500 million through foreign currency deposits and overseas borrowings.  This move joins other lenders accessing the central bank's concessional funding window.  The facility has already attracted over $32 billion in foreign currency inflows.  Non-resident deposits have been the primary driver of this significant mobilization.  This initiative aims to strengthen India's foreign exchange reserves effectively.

items.title: PPFAS valuation climbs after Rajeev Thakkar sells stake to WhiteOak AIF
items.description: Rajeev Thakkar sold a stake in PPFAS to WhiteOak Capital's AIF. This transaction valued the unlisted asset management company at nearly ₹15,800 crore. Promoters Neil and Khushboo Parikh also recently sold a stake in PPFAS. These deals provide valuation insights for the closely held company. PPFAS reported increased revenue and net profit in the last fiscal year.

items.title: D-St set for a positive opening as GIFT Nifty signals firm start
items.description: Indian stock markets experienced a muted trading session on Tuesday. The Sensex and Nifty indices erased early gains to close in the red. Broader markets showed mixed performance, with small caps declining and mid caps advancing. The Indian rupee strengthened for a third consecutive session against the US dollar. Foreign investors were net sellers, while domestic institutions were net buyers.

items.title: Stocks in news: L&T, Tata Capital, Ambuja Cements, Suzlon Energy, RVNL
items.description: Indian stock markets closed lower on Tuesday after early gains faded. Larsen & Toubro and Tata Capital reported strong profit growth for the quarter. Ambuja Cement and Suzlon Energy, however, saw their profits decline year-on-year. RVNL announced a record date for its final dividend and secured a new order. Phoenix Mills posted a profit increase, while VST Industries experienced a profit drop.

items.title: Indian IT stocks buck global tech slump, climb on earnings beat and AI optimism
items.description: Indian information technology stocks rallied Tuesday after global AI pressure eased. Coforge reported significant revenue and profit increases, boosting the sector. Other major IT firms also saw substantial gains during the trading session. This positive movement follows a period of underperformance for the IT sector this year. Analysts suggest resilient demand and attractive valuations are driving investor confidence.

items.title: ET Exclusive: Adani eyes controlling stake in UK's Associated British Ports
items.description: Adani Ports is weighing a bid for Associated British Ports in the UK. This acquisition would expand Gautam Adani's port empire significantly. Two Canadian pension funds are selling their controlling stake in Associated British Ports. Associated British Ports owns and operates twenty-one key ports across the United Kingdom. The company is also a partner for the offshore wind industry.

items.title: KPIT Technologies shares rise 4% ahead of Q1FY27 results
items.description: KPIT Technologies shares gained over 4% on July 29 to reach Rs 627.70 ahead of its Q1FY27 earnings announcement. Despite near-term momentum and strength in the broader IT sector, the stock remains under medium-term pressure following institutional stake reductions and lower revenue expectations for upcoming quarters.

items.title: Coforge shares rally 5% after strong Q1 earnings; net profit surges 63% YoY
items.description: Coforge shares surged after the IT services firm reported strong Q1 FY27 results. Net profit jumped 63% YoY, while revenue from operations rose 49% YoY to ₹5,527.7 crore, marking a 24% QoQ growth. The strong performance boosted investor sentiment toward the stock.

items.title: Mukul Agrawal, Ashish Kacholia, Dolly Khanna likely exited these 11 stocks in Q1. Do you own any?
items.description: Ace investors Mukul Agrawal, Ashish Kacholia, Dolly Khanna, known for spotting emerging small-cap winners, appear to have exited eleven stocks in the first quarter of FY27, booking profits in some while cutting exposure to others that have underperformed this year. Here's the full list.

items.title: IT stocks on a roll: TCS, Infosys, Coforge and others rally up to 5% for second straight day. What's driving this surge?
items.description: Indian IT stocks rallied for a second straight session, buoyed by strong Q1 earnings, optimism around AI-driven demand and improving investor sentiment. Jefferies turned neutral on the sector, citing positive FPI feedback and potential tactical upside after a sharp correction. The rally came despite a global tech selloff, with investors also awaiting the US Federal Reserve's policy decision.

items.title: Tata Capital shares rally 4% after Q1 profit surges 56%; AUM nears Rs 3 lakh crore
items.description: Tata Capital shares rose nearly 4% on Wednesday following a stellar Q1 FY27 performance. Consolidated net profit jumped 56% YoY to Rs 1,547 crore, while assets under management reached Rs 2.91 lakh crore. The NBFC also announced its strategic expansion into gold loans by acquiring an 88.6% stake in Yogloans.

items.title: Varun Beverages shares jump 3% after Q1 PAT rises 15%, revenue grows 20%
items.description: Varun Beverages reported a 15% profit and 20% revenue increase in Q1 FY2027. Consolidated sales volumes grew by nearly 20% driven by India and international markets. Gross margins expanded while depreciation and finance costs rose due to acquisitions. The company also announced a strategic alliance to introduce the Calpis brand. A second interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per share was approved by the board.

items.title: VST Industries shares slide 4% after Q1 profit drops 25%, revenue falls 13%
items.description: VST Industries shares fell over 4% on Wednesday after reporting a 25% YoY drop in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 42 crore and a 13% drop in revenue. The cigarette maker cited higher tax incidence, weak operating margins, and Middle East geopolitical tensions as key drag factors on performance.

items.title: Eternal shares jump over 20% in one month. Will the stock cross its October peak of Rs 368?
items.description: Eternal shares have surged over 20% in the past month. Analysts largely maintain a bullish outlook on the food delivery major. Experts highlight robust growth levers supporting future performance. Technical indicators suggest a positive shift in the stock's medium-term trend. The company's stock is currently trading below its October peak.

items.title: HUL shares rebound 2% after Q1 results. Here's what Morgan Stanley, Motilal Oswal and other brokerages are saying
items.description: Hindustan Unilever (HUL) shares rebounded 2.2% after brokerages retained bullish views despite the FMCG major reporting a 3% YoY decline in Q1 FY27 net profit that missed estimates. Revenue rose 10% to Rs 17,341 crore, driven by its strongest underlying sales growth in 13 quarters. The profit decline was due to a one-off tax credit in the year-ago period.

items.title: Ambuja Cements share price target: Nuvama, Motilal, other brokerages see up to 30% upside. Here's why
items.description: Ambuja Cements shares rose over 1% despite reporting a 34% YoY decline in Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 577 crore. Revenue fell 7.5%, while EBITDA dropped 19% and margins narrowed due to higher fuel and raw material costs amid the West Asia crisis. Despite the weak quarter, brokerages retained their 'Buy' ratings, citing strong long-term growth prospects.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex soars over 800 pts, Nifty tops 24,200; 4 key factors powering D-Street
items.description: Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty rose nearly one percent today. This surge occurred despite a sharp increase in oil prices due to escalating tensions. Several factors including global AI selloff resilience and rupee gains supported the market. Foreign institutional investors remained net buyers of Indian equities on Tuesday. The US Federal Reserve is expected to keep interest rates unchanged today.

items.title: Suzlon Energy share price target: Brokerages see up to 35% upside potential. Here’s why
items.description: Suzlon Energy's net profit fell nearly 6% year-on-year in the first quarter. Revenue from operations, however, grew over 22% during the same period. The company achieved its highest-ever first-quarter deliveries at 506 MW. Analysts maintain buy ratings, though some lowered price targets due to margin pressures. Geopolitical issues and logistics disruptions impacted the company's recent financial performance.

items.title: L&T shares rise 4% after Q1 earnings. Why Goldman Sachs, other brokerages remain bullish?
items.description: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) shares climbed after the company reported a 14% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to ₹4,123 crore. Revenue from operations grew 7% to ₹67,942 crore, with international business contributing 51% of total revenue. Following the strong earnings, brokerages maintained their 'Buy' ratings on the stock.

items.title: KPIT Tech Q1 Results: Shares rally 10% even as net profit drops 32% YoY to Rs 117 crore. Here's why
items.description: KPIT Technologies reported a 32% YoY decline in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 117 crore, but its shares surged 10% to Rs 662.65 as revenue grew 9% to Rs 1,675 crore, slightly topping management's previous outlook. The company also announced a final dividend of Rs 5.25 per share.

items.title: Devyani International Q1 profit zooms to Rs 17 cr
items.description: Devyani International has reported an impressive surge in net profit for the June quarter, marking a substantial revenue increase of 16.47% to Rs 1,580.51 crore. Likewise, total income experienced a robust rise of 16.72%. They earlier announced a merger with Sapphire Foods India, setting the stage for the formation of one of the largest quick-service restaurant chains in the country.

items.title: Adani Group raises Rs 43,500 crore, now plans another $3-4 billion in 6 months
items.description: The Adani Group is planning to raise another $3–4 billion over the next six months after mobilising Rs 43,500 crore through equity fundraising in the past nine months. Adani Green, Adani Ports and Adani Enterprises are expected to lead the fundraising, even as domestic mutual funds have raised their holdings in key Adani companies to a record Rs 1 lakh crore.

items.title: Swiggy shares jump 8%, rally 15% in 3 days. What's boosting investor sentiment?
items.description: Swiggy shares climbed significantly, extending recent gains for a third consecutive session. Nandita Sinha, former Myntra CEO, now leads Swiggy's Instamart business.This appointment occurs amid intense competition in India's quick commerce sector. Meanwhile, Zepto is reportedly negotiating its IPO pricing at a lower valuation.The company may defer its listing if valuation targets are not met.

items.title: Time to take a little risk with a 1- to 2-year perspective? 5 mid-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential up to 20%
items.description: When the big picture is a coin-toss, why waste time on predictions? What is the big picture? Well, nobody knows. Anyone who says with confidence where crude, or the tariff talks, or the monsoon, or earnings may land over the next few months (or quarters, for earnings) is just guessing. We are not saying that they are lying, but guessing. It is the guessing part that needs to be avoided at this point of time.

items.title: CarTrade Tech shares slip 7% despite 19% YoY rise in Q1 profit; EBITDA surges 45%
items.description: CarTrade Tech shares fell over 7% despite the company reporting a strong Q1 FY27 performance, with consolidated net profit rising 19% YoY to Rs 51 crore. Revenue from operations grew 16% to Rs 201 crore, while total income hit a record Rs 230 crore. EBITDA surged 45% YoY to Rs 63 crore, with margins improving to 31%.

items.title: Thangamayil Jewellery Q1 Results: Net profit spikes 86% YoY to Rs 85 crore; stock tanks 10% on weak guidance
items.description: Thangamayil Jewellery shares tumbled despite strong Q1 FY27 results. The company reported an 86% YoY rise in net profit to ₹85 crore, while revenue from operations surged 71.2% to ₹2,666.4 crore in the June quarter.

items.title: BlueStone Jewellery shares soar 7%. Should you buy at current levels or avoid?
items.description: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle shares surged nearly 7%, extending their one-month rally to around 50% after robust Q1 FY27 earnings. The company reported a net profit of Rs 14 crore against a year-ago loss, while revenue rose 49% and EBITDA more than doubled. Analysts say the uptrend remains intact, but investors should watch key technical support and resistance levels.

items.title: SML Mahindra to acquire Mahindra Truck and Bus division in commercial vehicle consolidation
items.description: SML Mahindra will acquire Mahindra Truck and Bus Division from Mahindra & Mahindra through a slump sale in FY27. The deal consolidates truck and bus operations, expands its commercial vehicle portfolio, enhances scale, unlocks synergies and strengthens competitiveness across above-3.5 tonne segments.

items.title: Why did market rise today? Sensex soars 890 pts, Nifty closes above 24,250; 4 factors behind Rs 4 lakh crore gains on D-Street
items.description: Indian stock markets experienced a significant surge on Wednesday. Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty both rose over one percent. This occurred despite a sharp increase in oil prices due to US-Iran tensions. Broader markets also traded positively, with IT and Metal sectors leading gains. Market volatility remained subdued as broader markets showed strength.

items.title: These 15 midcap stocks soared up to 98% in a year; check FII and MF holdings
items.description: While the Nifty50 has declined about 3% over the past year, the Nifty Midcap 150 has delivered a modest gain of nearly 8%. But the real story lies beneath the surface. Several midcap stocks have significantly outperformed the broader index, posting remarkable gains during the same period. As many as 31 midcap stocks have rallied more than 25% over the past year. Of these, 15 stocks have soared between 50% and 98%, emerging as the biggest wealth creators in the segment. We also examined how key institutional investors, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and mutual funds (MFs), positioned themselves in these high-performing stocks during the June 2026 quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity)
